program.section_heading: 4. Certificate of Competency, ESL Low Intermediate B
outcomes: Write complete affirmative and negative statements and questions in various tenses. Use comparatives and superlatives to compare two or more things.
Interpret short narratives and descriptions using contextual clues.
Ask for and give information using simple and progressive forms of present and past tenses and using two forms for future.
Express permission, ability, advice, and obligation.
Use present perfect to describe experiences using common regular and irregular verbs as well and “since” and “for”.
Discuss abilities and experience orally and in writing in paragraph format with appropriate punctuation.

blocks.name: Certificate of Competency, ESL Low Intermediate B

notes: Noncredit certificate of competency, but the catalog prints units ('Total 0 Units', 'Complete the following number of credits: 0') and no hours, so measure is 'units' and total_units is the printed 0.

ESLN035 and ESLN035L (the 'Long' version of the same course) are listed together under 'Complete the following' with no 'or'; recorded as both required, but they may be alternative versions of one course. Reviewer should check.
Catalog codes ESLN035/ESLN035L match closed-list ESLN 35/ESLN 035L.
The first printed outcome line contains two sentences; recorded as one outcome as printed on a single line.
Source URL references fall 2020; catalog page may reflect an earlier version of the program.
